Argo — autonomous agent runtime on GitHub

Argo is a Rust workspace that ships an autonomous agent runtime: vertical-bound sessions, multi-step worker loops, provider transports, capability checks, and an MCP plugin surface. Built by Mark Hallam.

Anthropic — Tool use guide for Claude

Tool use lets Claude call functions you define. Argo implements this with an in-core tool registry and per-call capability checks before dispatch.

Model Context Protocol — Spec

The Model Context Protocol defines the wire format Argo uses to delegate browser, voice, and (eventually) web search/extract to dedicated MCP servers.
